_comment: Product/payload version (version and payloadVersion) is independent of launcherVersion. npm start destage staging product version (chips, image dates, changelog, arch enablement) always comes from this file. Changelog entries are only for official RELEASE/MAJOR cuts pushed to the public main release feed (not per-DEV destage bumps). Packaged Dev and production changelog/update feeds use public GitHub latest.json (main) or latest-dev.json (packaged Dev). The ISO share and Drive VERSION.json must not host launcher exe, payload zip, or live version overlay.

dev._comment: npm start destage always versions from this checkout VERSION.json (local ISO, HQ UNC, Drive Desktop, or any other media). Packaged Dev uses the public dev branch / latest-dev.json. Packaged production uses main / latest.json. ISO/PreSplit/WinPE-OCs are filesystem-only: Google Drive for Desktop if mounted, else HQ UNC. A Drive folder URL is never ShareRoot. Do not publish exe/zip to Drive. Do not overlay Drive HTTPS VERSION.json on destage.

Official release 5.1.42 - first cut release of the v5 line (RELEASE 0->1; DEV stays at 42 per the MAJOR.RELEASE.DEV scheme - DEV only resets on a new MAJOR). Consolidates all 5.0.1-5.0.42 development work into a shippable build.

LoneWolf USB build: the launcher drives the proven local builder (Invoke-LoneWolfBuild.ps1) with a default Single FAT32 (GPT Basic Data) layout that mirrors Build-UsbStick.ps1 - full ISO copy incl. \boot, stock ISO BCD shipped verbatim (no hand-authored/{fwbootmgr} store), signed EFI loaders copied byte-for-byte (Secure Boot preserved), install.wim auto-split to install.swm for the FAT32 4 GB limit, WinPE OCs pulled per-architecture from the share, parallel multi-stick builds, newest ISO auto-mounted from the share, volume label 'LoneWolf', and live JSON build progress in the UI.

WinPE deploy: reliable boot into custom WinPE and image apply with live same-line DISM progress for the split image, force-boot to the internal Windows Boot Manager, and a clean console (the recurring 'The system cannot find the path specified.' end-of-deploy noise eliminated).

OOBE/MDM provisioning (Option B): operator finalize + MDM/Autopilot scrub run inline as SYSTEM in the Administrator audit session with per-item verification; the temporary MDM/Autopilot block is applied at SetupComplete, persists through the whole audit/OOBE sit, and is reliably removed at operator settings-close (residue confirmed clean on-device). The operator Settings gate opens maximized in front (splash stands aside), waits for a real strict-liveness window close, then seals with sysprep /oobe /shutdown (power off into OOBE, no reboot-to-login). A self-deleting final-ship reaper guarantees no FirstBase files/tasks/RunOnce/Startup remain on the shipped device.
